_help.awardsFor2: End screen: how many highlight awards show in a 2-player game.
_help.awardsFor3: How many highlight awards show in a 3-player game.
_help.awardsFor4: How many highlight awards show in a 4-player game.
_help.awardPriority: Which awards may show, and in what order they are picked: 1 = picked first. 0 = never shown. No player gets a second award until everyone has one. Awards never add Magic.
_help.photoFinishMax: Photo finish: the winner won by this much Magic or less (it then replaces The deciding turn).
_help.comebackMin: Comeback: the winner must have been behind by at least this much Magic at some point.
_help.twoBirdsMin: Two birds: the most words in one cast must be at least this many.
_help.secretLeaderMinRounds: Secret leader: led (alone) after at least this many rounds.
_help.generousMin: Generous gardener: at least this many of a player's seeds were used in rivals' words.
_help.maxMarkers: Story chart: the most moment markers drawn on the lines (tangles first, then award moments, then lead changes).
_help.chartDrawSeconds: Story chart: how long the lines take to draw themselves in, left to right, when the page opens (0 = at once; reduce motion = at once).
_help.chartLineWidth: Story chart: line thickness, in chart units (the chart is 360 wide).
_help.chartHeight: Story chart: height, in chart units (the chart is 360 wide).
